title: DARPA SUBOFF bare hull, Re=1000 — total drag (friction+pressure)

reference.name: Blasius laminar flat-plate Cf = 1.328/sqrt(Re) (wetted-area pi*D*L)
reference.note: benchmarks/TODO.md lists 'Ct=0.004 (exp)' for B6, but that value is the AFF-8 full-scale Re=2e6 total-drag coefficient (src/tensorlbm/suboff_reference_data.py), NOT applicable to Re=1000. The repo Re=1000 family reference is Blasius 0.041995 — the same frame in which the historical 3.8% (CUDA) / 3.6% (SDAA) errors were measured.

acceptance.criterion: end-to-end Cd_tot within +/-3% of Blasius 0.041995 (true simulation, no extrapolation) AND time-converged window mean

compile_routing.step_fn: lbm_step_correct(f, collide_fn, tau, solid, u_in, far_field_fn) — collide -> NoDynamics -> half-way BB -> stream -> far-field BC
compile_routing.step_dependent_branches_outside: mass-correction cadence (step % 200 == 0), force sampling (step % 10 == 0), snapshots, NaN guard — all eager in run.py's driver loop (compile_route rule #2)

primary_config.friction_formula_note: mix50 = 0.5*cd_f_standard + 0.5*cd_f_faces: standard (near-wall cell sum) is a lower bound, faces (voxel stair per-face) an upper bound; the geometric face/cell ratio +49% is only partly realised in the real flow (uniform-field faces/standard = 1.396, actual 1.221), so mix50 splits the two bounds.

convergence.method: sliding last-10000-step window mean of engine force samples (sampled every 10 steps), rescaled frontal->wetted
convergence.note: window mean decreases monotonically 0.051099 -> 0.041513 and plateaus (drift < 4e-6/window at the tail): the L=80 flow is time-converged by 12000 steps.

final_field_recheck.note: recomputed on the saved converged field with the same common modules; cd_p/cd_f_standard match the last-500 window (0.005537/0.032317) -> converged field, not a transient. p0 far_field/domain_avg/inlet shift Cd_tot_mix50 by <0.07%.

grids.verdict: coarse grid (hull radius ~2.8 cells) — slightly over, residual discretisation error
control — shows the standard friction formula underestimates by ~10%

convergence_with_grid.note: error shrinks with resolution (coarse L=48 -3.17% -> L=80 -1.15%), consistent with a true convergent scheme.

timing.note: 3.75x SDAA speedup made L=80 feasible (previously 3.7 s/step = blocked).

artifacts.e2e_helpers: scripts/_suboff_e2e_monitor.py (out-of-band progress monitor, run.py unmodified), scripts/_suboff_e2e_launch.sh

history_note: Lineage: standard friction formula gave L=80/96 Cd_tot ~0.0378 (-9.85%/-10.09%, systematic ~10% under-prediction of the friction-dominated drag); the faces (voxel-stair) formula overcorrected to +6.5~+10.6%; mix50 (mid-point of the two bounds) reaches -1.15% end-to-end at L=80. Full failure-analysis trail (L=96 faces re-eval, L=128 OOM, etc.) is in git history prior to commit 5c57065 (benchmarks/pending/suboff_re1000/result.json).
